summary: Stereo chorus of one to six modulated delay taps with their minimum delay, swing depth, rate, tap count and the stereo phase between the sides. A fixed dry and wet mix. For widening guitars, pads and synths; Neo Ensemble is the modern chorus.
use_for: Stereo chorus with one to six taps for widening guitars, pads and synths.
quirks: All five parameters are track parameters of its one track; there is no dry/wet control: the dry signal is a fixed 29 percent of the output and the taps 71 percent (read from its code).
Taps are spaced a sixth of a cycle apart in their LFO phase; Stereo phase reaches 180 degrees divided by the tap count.
Its times count samples at 44.1 kHz, so they shrink in milliseconds at higher sample rates; its own text for Minimum delay is 1.6 percent short of what the code delays.
Level: -5.5 dB at its defaults on the profile's test signal (the taps are averaged).

track_parameters.name: Min Delay
track_parameters.description: Minimum Delay. (2 + 1102.5·v/240) samples as its text says, in seconds at 44.1 kHz (they scale with the rate); its Work delays 2 + 1120.5·v/240 samples, 1.6 % more
track_parameters.how: Sets the shortest delay the taps reach, from about 0.05 ms to 25 ms (2 to 1,104 samples at 44.1 kHz in its own text; the code uses 1.6 percent more).
track_parameters.sound: Short values give a tight, flanger-like comb; 10 to 25 ms gives the open, separate voices of a chorus.

track_parameters.name: Mod Depth
track_parameters.description: Modulation Depth. 110.25·v/240 samples either way of the minimum delay's, in seconds at 44.1 kHz
track_parameters.how: Sets how far each tap's delay swings, from 0 to 2.5 ms (0 to 110 samples at 44.1 kHz).
track_parameters.sound: More depth means more pitch wobble and a wider shimmer; at 0 the taps stand still and only thicken the sound.

track_parameters.name: Mod Rate
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the taps sweep, from 0 to 6.6 Hz in 240 steps.
track_parameters.sound: Slow rates give a gentle drift; the top of the range is a fast, almost vibrato-like wobble.

track_parameters.name: Fatness
track_parameters.how: Sets how many modulated taps are mixed in, from 1 to 6, their sweeps spaced a sixth of a cycle apart.
track_parameters.sound: More taps thicken the sound into a lush ensemble; one tap is a plain chorus.

track_parameters.name: Stereo
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the right side's sweep runs ahead of the left's: 0 to 180 degrees, divided by the number of taps.
track_parameters.sound: At 0 both sides move together; larger values spread the shimmer across the stereo field.
